## Summary

Describe what changed and why. For news, model specifications, licensing,
pricing or lifecycle changes, link the primary source and give its date.

## Test plan

- [ ] Run `python3 scripts/check_content.py`.
- [ ] Run Markdown lint and the full link check in `MAINTENANCE.md`.
- [ ] Review redirects, any access restrictions, and upstream maintenance.
- [ ] Update the dated audit with sources, commands, results and limitations.
